settings.colorThemePastelStory: Inspired by IKEA's GRÅVITS vase, I was fortunate to discover phycat in the Typora community. Its light, airy cherry-blossom palette and relaxed, warm atmosphere were exactly what I had in mind. Through layer-by-layer refinements and adaptations, it became a soft, soothing, and effortlessly comfortable writing experience for Textox.
settings.colorThemeSpringStory: Spring represents renewal and hope. Textox launched in spring 2026, a momentous season for the project. The Jingzhe theme features clean, gentle botanical greens, perfectly echoing the community's spring theme with the vitality of awakening nature. Adapted and refined for Textox, it brings a fresh, crisp spring morning atmosphere to every writing session.
